meta.name: Send weekly AI crawler visibility reports with Cloudflare, Claude, and Telegram/email

parameters.content:
## 🤖 AI Crawler Visibility Report

### How it works
Runs on a schedule and queries Cloudflare's Analytics API for AI crawler traffic on your domain (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and others), by matching known user-agents. It totals requests per bot, writes a plain-language summary, and sends it by email and/or Telegram -- so you know which AI engines are actually visiting your content, without digging through Cloudflare's dashboard.

### Setup steps
- Edit CONFIG: your Cloudflare Zone ID, site name, lookback window, alert email, and Telegram chat ID.
- Create a Cloudflare API Token (My Profile -> API Tokens -> Create Token -> Zone > Analytics > Read, scoped to your specific zone) and add it as a Header Auth credential (Name: Authorization, Value: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN) on the 'Query Cloudflare Analytics' node.
- Add your Anthropic API credential (used to write the plain-language summary).
- Add SMTP and/or Telegram credentials for delivery.

### Customization
Add or remove bots to track in CONFIG's AI_BOTS_TO_TRACK field. Note: on Cloudflare's free plan, analytics data is only retained for 24 hours -- keep LOOKBACK_DAYS at 1 unless you're on a paid plan.

## Load config & fetch AI crawler data

Loads CONFIG, builds a GraphQL query for the known AI bots you're tracking, and queries Cloudflare's Analytics API for matching requests in your lookback window.

## Aggregate & summarize

Totals requests per bot (exact counts, computed in code -- not estimated by the AI), then has Claude write a short plain-language report.

## Send report

Sends the report through email and/or Telegram, independently toggled via CONFIG.
